title: International Shipping Favor
scenario: A student asks you to receive packages and forward them for easy cash.

answers.A: Verify inside the official university/account system.
answers.B: Click/apply/pay quickly before the deadline passes.
answers.C: Reply to the message and ask the sender for proof.
answers.D: Contact the relevant office using published contact details.

explanation: International Shipping Favor: the trap is to pull you away from the normal verification path. The safer move is to verify through an official or approved channel, not to act before verifying.
proTip: Reshipping jobs can involve stolen goods or fraud.
